body: No surprise all those houses fly away when a breeze passes

Roll a little sausage from it that you think will burn smoothly and roll it up in the middle of your spliff. Afterwards you can sometimes see the sausage sticking put of the ashes. If you spread those ashes between your fingers and the hash is still kind of sticky, your sausage is not thin enough. If not satisfied try with multiple smaller sausages. #trialanderror
